summary_1line: After the Pandavas leave for exile, Bhishma rebukes Duryodhana and Karna; Karna vows to prove his worth and launches a campaign conquering many kingdoms.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma stands in the Kuru court rebuking Duryodhana while the young king laughs dismissively beside Karna and Shakuni.
Karna raises his weapon before Duryodhana and swears to conquer the earth single-handed while the court listens.
Karna's army surrounds the city of Drupada as chariots, elephants, and banners fill the battlefield before the walls.
